title: Waiting Periods Quick Reference for BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies
content:
Three waiting periods are fixed for each tier of BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines), all counted in calendar days: the waiting period from receipt of the signed application and payment to coverage attaching; the waiting period when the policy is bound for a commercial loan closing and received by the closing date; and the waiting period for a location added mid-term.

## Waiting periods (calendar days)

| Tier | Standard (from receipt of signed application and payment) | Bound for a commercial loan closing, received by the closing date | Location added mid-term |
|---|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | 15 | 0 | 15 |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | 15 | 0 | 15 |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | 15 | 0 | 15 |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | 15 | 0 | 15 |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | 15 | 0 | 15 |
| BizFlood Large Property | 15 | 0 | 15 |

## Quick reading

- The figures are the same on all six tiers.
- The standard waiting period and the waiting period for an added location are each 15 calendar days.
- A policy bound for a commercial loan closing and received by the closing date has a waiting period of 0 days.
- The periods are counted in calendar days.
